_about: 1화 「얼음광」 캐스트. 턴어라운드 대상 4명(편당 2~4명 상한). 아이는 정서적 배경으로만 쓰고 시트를 만들지 않는다(세이프티 가드레일). lock·negatives·anchorProp는 영문 전용 — 한글을 쓰면 모델이 시트 안에 캡션으로 그린다.
_anchor_plan: 축·색이 캐스트 안에서 겹치지 않게: 덕보=실루엣(장신·넓은 어깨)+회색 / 순덕=시그니처 색(바랜 쪽빛 치마) / 막실=크고 단순한 얼굴 특징(흰 수염)+굽은 등+황토색 / 청지기=착용 소품(갓·부채)+미색. 모자는 청지기 하나만.
_faceprint_plan: 같은 성별·연령대끼리 얼굴형·눈매를 다르게: 덕보(젊은 남) long-narrow/deep-set ↔ 청지기(중년 남) square-jawed/upturned ↔ 막실(노년 남) broad-flat/narrow-slit. 2화 캐스트를 만들 때 이 표와 대조할 것.

s1_deokbo.name: 덕보

physical.build: tall, broad-shouldered, lean and hard from labour
physical.hair: black hair tied in a plain topknot, no hat

s1_deokbo.anchorProp: a coarse grey hemp jacket with a wide twisted-rope belt at the waist
s1_deokbo.anchorProp_ko: 거친 회색 삼베 저고리 + 허리에 굵은 새끼줄 띠
s1_deokbo.lock: A 29-year-old Korean man, tall and broad-shouldered, lean from hard labour. long narrow face, hollow gaunt cheeks, deep-set eyes, high straight nose, thick dark straight brows, weather-reddened cheeks. Black hair in a plain topknot, no hat. Quiet expression.
negatives: NO round or soft face, NO plump cheeks
NO blue or indigo clothing, NO brown or ochre clothing

s1_sundeok.name: 순덕

physical.build: small, slight frame, thin from hunger
physical.hair: black hair pulled into a low tight bun with a plain wooden pin

s1_sundeok.anchorProp: a faded indigo-dyed cotton skirt with a frayed hem, worn with a plain undyed white jacket
s1_sundeok.anchorProp_ko: 바랜 쪽빛 무명 치마(단이 해짐) + 무명 흰 저고리
s1_sundeok.lock: A Korean woman in her mid-twenties, small and slight, thin from hunger. oval face, flat low cheekbones, downturned eyes, small pointed nose, thin sparse brows, pale skin, faint vertical frown line. Black hair in a low tight bun with a plain wooden pin. Guarded unsmiling expression.
negatives: NO large round eyes, NO full cheeks
NO grey clothing, NO red or pink clothing
NO ornate hairpin, NO jewelry, NO makeup

s1_maksil.name: 막실 노인

physical.hair: thin white hair in a small topknot, thin white beard

s1_maksil.anchorProp: a thin white beard and a stooped back, in a faded ochre-brown jacket
s1_maksil.anchorProp_ko: 가늘고 흰 수염 + 굽은 등 + 바랜 황토색 저고리
s1_maksil.lock: A Korean man in his late sixties, short, wiry, shoulders rounded forward. broad flat face, heavy jowls, narrow slit eyes, large bulbous nose, faded grey brows, deep nasolabial folds. Thin white hair in a small topknot, thin white beard, no hat. Fond expression. Shown from the waist up.
negatives: NO cartoon caricature, NO thick heavy outlines, NO exaggerated features
NO grey clothing, NO indigo clothing

s1_steward.name: 청지기

physical.hair: black hair under a black horsehair hat

s1_steward.anchorProp: a black horsehair gat hat and a pale cream overcoat, holding a closed folding fan
s1_steward.anchorProp_ko: 검은 갓 + 미색 두루마기 + 접은 부채
s1_steward.lock: A Korean man in his mid-forties, visibly middle-aged, well-fed with a fuller face and a slight double chin, upright posture. square jaw, high cheekbones, upturned eyes with faint crow's feet, slightly hooked nose, sharply angled brows, thin lips. He wears a wide-brimmed black horsehair gat hat in EVERY view including the front view. Composed expression.
negatives: NO bare head, NO view without the gat hat
NO youthful face, NO slender young man
NO grey, ochre or indigo clothing
